description: 48 patches across Feeld, FolderSync, Hidrate Spark, Meetup, Met Office, Tinder, and X, plus universal PairIP license-check bypass, universal OneTrust consent-banner auto-reject, and universal MITM patches (trust user CAs + bypass OkHttp pinning). For X 12.7.1-release.0: 'Show age-restricted and sensitive media' drops the media-visibility results X attaches to covered posts, so neither the age-restricted 'verify your age' cover nor the ordinary sensitive-media cover is built (complements Piko's 'Show sensitive media'); v1.5.0 adds 'Bypass version deprecation notice', which reports a newer client version so the server stops serving the undismissable 'This app is out of date' gate (spoofedVersion patch option, default 12.99.0-release.0). The remaining X patches ('Bypass PairIP integrity', 'Remove promoted timeline items') are still pinned to 12.4.1 and default-off. Purchase-breaking Tinder paywall patches and the umbrellas are default-off too.
